findings.description: The RDS instance sets publicly_accessible = true, giving it a public endpoint reachable from the internet rather than keeping it private to the VPC. This dramatically increases attack surface for a MySQL database holding application data.
storage_encrypted = false disables KMS encryption of the RDS storage volume and snapshots, leaving database data unprotected at rest.

The master username is a predictable 'admin' and the password is passed via a Terraform variable, which is persisted in cleartext in the Terraform state and is also propagated into EC2 user data; no secrets manager integration is used.

The MySQL parameter group applied to this instance does not enforce require_secure_transport, so clients (including the PHP app connecting via mysqli without TLS options) may transmit credentials and data in cleartext.

The inline role policy grants s3:*, ec2:* and rds:* on Resource "*", violating least privilege. Because this role is attached via an instance profile to an internet-facing web server, compromise of the app yields near-total control of S3, EC2 and RDS, including privilege escalation and data exfiltration.

The user_data script writes the database username and password into /var/www/inc/dbinfo.inc in cleartext; EC2 user data is retrievable from the instance metadata service (and via DescribeInstanceAttribute), exposing the RDS master credentials.

No metadata_options block enforcing http_tokens = "required", so IMDSv1 remains enabled. Combined with a web application on the host and a highly privileged instance profile, SSRF against 169.254.169.254 can steal role credentials and the user-data secrets.
No root_block_device / ebs_block_device encryption is configured, so the instance volume (which stores the plaintext dbinfo.inc credentials file) is unencrypted at rest.
Egress allows all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0 from the RDS security group, permitting unrestricted outbound traffic and easing data exfiltration or C2 from a compromised resource.

The RDS security group has no description and relies on separate rules; combined with publicly_accessible = true on the instance, network segmentation for the database depends solely on this group, which also has unrestricted egress.
